features.title: Monitor your portfolio
features.description: See live power and today's energy use for every building on one screen.

features.title: See usage on a map
features.description: A heatmap shows which sites use the most energy. Slide back in time or look ahead.

features.title: Explore each building in 3D
features.description: Turn a model of the building around and find the sensor that is working too hard.

features.title: Catch anomalies early
features.description: You get an alert when a reading leaves its normal range.

features.title: Benchmark performance
features.description: Put two buildings side by side and find out which one uses energy better.

features.title: Forecast tomorrow's demand
features.description: Plan your week with an hourly forecast. Switch to twelve weeks for the long view.

features.title: Act on load shifting insights
features.description: Each tip names the load to move and what you could save every month.

features.title: Keep tariffs and costs current
features.description: Enter your summer and winter rates. Every cost then matches your real bill.

outcomes.title: Peak load reduction
outcomes.description: Moving load out of peak hours keeps demand under your contract limit.

outcomes.title: Forecast error
outcomes.description: Our forecasts stay close to what your buildings really use.

outcomes.title: Buildings online
outcomes.description: Meters and sensors connect in days rather than months.

outcomes.title: Live refresh
outcomes.description: Readings on screen are never more than a few seconds old.

outcomes.title: Measures watched
outcomes.description: Every reading is checked on four measures for unusual jumps.

outcomes.title: Forecast horizon
outcomes.description: Look one week ahead in detail or twelve weeks ahead for the bigger picture.

outcomes.title: Audit ready reports
outcomes.description: Download a signed report that your auditor can check against the records.

outcomes.title: ESG health score
outcomes.description: Try a change with a slider and watch your score move before you spend anything.
